questions.prompt: Which city was the capital of the Aztec Empire?
questions.fact: It was built on an island and fed by chinampas, artificial garden plots floating in the surrounding lake.

questions.prompt: Which organ in the human body regenerates most readily after damage?
questions.fact: As little as a quarter of it can regrow to full size, which is what makes living donor transplants possible.

questions.prompt: Which country hosts the Monaco Grand Prix?
questions.fact: The circuit runs on public roads, and the barriers and grandstands are assembled and removed every year.

questions.prompt: Which actor voiced Darth Vader in the original Star Wars trilogy?
questions.fact: The actor inside the suit spoke every line on set, and only discovered at the premiere that his voice had been replaced.

questions.prompt: Which African country was never colonised by a European power?
questions.fact: It defeated an invading Italian army at Adwa in 1896, one of the few decisive African victories of that era.

questions.prompt: Which novel is set in the fictional town of Maycomb?
questions.fact: Its author published nothing else for fifty-five years, and the eventual second book was an early draft of the first.

questions.prompt: What is the name for software distributed with its source code freely available?
questions.fact: Free in this sense refers to liberty rather than price, a distinction its advocates have spent decades explaining.
